sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Construct used in a large-scale functional screening campaign of 412 ORs; no OR51A7-specific functional result (e.g., agonist-evoked cAMP or calcium response) is reported in the cited clip. NOT MEASURED at single-receptor resolution.
sites.rationale: OR51A7 is a class-A GPCR with no signal peptide; the topology landmarks place residues 1–24 extracellularly and the C-terminus (294–312) intracellularly, making the N-terminus the sole extracellular terminus available for an N-terminal tag. The paper names no residue, so the junction is topology-derived: insert_after_residue = 0 (prepend before Met-1). Python confirms residue_after = 'M' (seq[0]). TM1 begins at residue 25, giving 24 residues of extracellular buffer between the tag and the first TM helix, well above the 3-residue minimum. OR51A7 full-length receptor cloned into pME18S with N-terminal FLAG and 20-aa bovine rhodopsin epitope tags fused to the receptor N-terminus for heterologous expression and functional screening of 412 olfactory receptors (PMC9022881). No specific residue number is named; the tag is described only as 'N-terminal'.

sources.claim: Each of the amplified receptor genes was inserted into the pME18S vector to generate OR proteins fused with N-terminal epitope tags of FLAG and 20 N-terminal amino acids of bovine rhodopsin.

literature_notes: Only one ledger line (L1) is provided. It reports a full-length, membrane-anchored OR51A7 construct carrying N-terminal FLAG and rhodopsin-20aa epitope tags used in a 412-OR heterologous-expression screen. The clip names no insertion residue, and the N-terminus is the only extracellular terminus on this GPCR (C-terminus is intracellular per landmarks), so the position is topology-derived as a prepend (insert_after_residue = 0). No internal-loop insertions are supported by the ledger; ECL1 (83–97), ECL2 (164–195), and ECL3 (261–272) are extracellular but have no ledger-grounded insertion evidence and are therefore not proposed. Validation level is 'detected_only' because the clip does not report a per-receptor functional readout for OR51A7.
